name: Calculator
highLevelGoals: The user aims to perform fundamental mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division accurately and efficiently using the smartphone app.
The user desires a simple and clear interface that allows for easy input of numbers and selection of operations, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free calculation experience.
The user expects the calculation results to be displayed prominently and updated instantly after each operation, enabling quick verification of answers.
lowLevelGoals: The user can input a single digit (0-9) into the calculator's display.
The user can select one of the basic arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /) to apply to the current number.
The user can trigger the calculation to display the final result after inputting numbers and an operation.
The user can clear the current number or the entire calculation from the display.
The user can add a decimal point to the number being entered, allowing for non-integer calculations.
The user can interact with the visual representation of numerical buttons (0-9) on the screen.
The user can interact with the visual representation of operation buttons (+, -, *, /) on the screen.
The user can interact with the visual representation of the equals button (=) to finalize a calculation.
The user can interact with the visual representation of the clear button (C or AC) to reset the calculator.
The system should render the digits and decimal point entered by the user in a prominent display area.
The system should render the final calculated value in a prominent display area after the equals button is pressed.
The system should refresh the display immediately to reflect the latest input or intermediate calculation state.
